5 /-! Separate the completed cases from the precise face sizes still requiring an unfolding. -/
6 
7 namespace SixVertexUnfolding
8 
9 /-- A five-vertex solid is already unfolded unless every original facet is triangular. -/
10 theorem five_vertex_reduction (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (size : P.vertices.card = 5) :
11     P.HasEdgeUnfolding ∨ ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 := by
12   by_cases triangular : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3
13   · exact Or.inr triangular
14   push Not at triangular
15   obtain ⟨F, not_triangle⟩ := triangular
16   have lower := F.three_le_vertex_count
17   have upper := F.vertex_count_lt
18   exact Or.inl (every_five_vertex_polyhedron_with_quadrilateral_face P size F (by omega))
19 
20 /-- A six-vertex solid is already unfolded unless its facets are triangles and quadrilaterals. -/
21 theorem six_vertex_reduction (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (size : P.vertices.card = 6) :
22     P.HasEdgeUnfolding ∨ ∀ F : P.Face,
23       (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
24       (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4 := by
25   by_cases small : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
26       (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4
27   · exact Or.inr small
28   push Not at small
29   obtain ⟨F, not_triangle, not_quadrilateral⟩ := small
30   have lower := F.three_le_vertex_count
31   have upper := F.vertex_count_lt
32   exact Or.inl (every_six_vertex_polyhedron_with_pentagonal_face P size F (by omega))
33 
34 /-- The completed constructions leave only six vertices with triangular or quadrilateral facets. -/
35 theorem unfolding_or_remaining_cases (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (at_most_six : P.vertices.card ≤ 6) :
36     P.HasEdgeUnfolding ∨
37       (P.vertices.card = 6 ∧ ∀ F : P.Face,
38         (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
39         (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4) := by
40   rcases P.vertex_count_cases at_most_six with four | five | six
41   · exact Or.inl (every_convex_polyhedron_with_four_vertices P four)
42   · exact Or.inl (every_convex_polyhedron_with_five_vertices P five)
43   · rcases six_vertex_reduction P six with unfolded | small_faces
44     · exact Or.inl unfolded
45     · exact Or.inr ⟨six, small_faces⟩
46 
47 end SixVertexUnfolding
